tldr: Mercury in the 1st house: thinking becomes personal through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
body:
With Mercury in the 1st house, this part of you works through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life. Mercury describes thinking, communication, learning, writing, and the way the mind makes connections. In practice, this brings attention to how you enter the room, respond first, take up space, and let the world meet you.

When this placement is supported, you can meet life with more self-trust and less need to explain yourself first. Mercury can become clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening.

When it is strained, you may become overly focused on how you are seen, or push your body past what it is trying to tell you. The harder pattern can show up as overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said.
gift: clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said around identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
